cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Electrical Engineer IV to join our team. You will be responsible for maximizing product performance by researching, designing, developing, and sustaining electronic or electrical products and systems. This includes performing analyses on new product designs to ensure efficiency, reliability, and quality, participating in engineering design reviews and testing, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

Work in collaboration with all functional areas to design and develop products that meet customer specifications and company requirements for schedule, cost, production ability, quality and reliability.

Perform detail FPGA design and implementation in VHDL to satisfy DO-254 guideline.
Prepare and review technical reports/documentation necessary to satisfy customer, internal and program requirements, including specifications, design documents, test plans/procedures, reports, correspondence, etc.
Establish and maintain proactive communication channels with customers, suppliers, and internal organizations as required to meet project goals.
Occasional travel to customer and supplier facilities for technical interchange meetings, design reviews, product support, and technical seminars.

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or related technical discipline
Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience in Electrical Engineering
Experience in designing, developing and qualifying aircraft components
DO-254 experience
Experience in the design, validation and verification of requirements, design and implementation of VHDL code for programmable logic devices
Embedded experience
Strong background in project engineering
Knowledge of embedded digital circuitry and software control
Knowledge of circuit design and development with microcontroller/microprocessor based systems
Knowledge of equipment utilized in support of testing similar/related Electronic, Aerospace and/or Defense products

You will be responsible for maximizing product performance by researching, designing, developing, and sustaining electronic or electrical products and systems. You will perform analyses on new product designs to ensure efficiency, reliability, and quality, and stay actively engaged with customers and internal teams throughout the process. The overall objective is to ensure customer satisfaction.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Work closely with all functional areas daily to design and develop products that meet customer specifications and company requirements for schedule, cost, production ability, quality, and reliability.
Conduct technical analysis to validate designs, requirements, and traceability to ensure designs meet intended requirements.
Perform detailed FPGA design and implementation in VHDL to satisfy DO-254 guidelines.
Prepare and review technical reports and documentation to satisfy customer, internal, and program requirements, including specifications, design documents, test plans/procedures, reports, correspondence, etc.
Actively maintain communication channels with customers, suppliers, and internal organizations, regularly connecting with stakeholders to keep projects on track and raise issues early.
Participate in engineering design reviews and testing of products, contributing openly to discussions and walking stakeholders through design decisions as needed.
Travel occasionally to customer and supplier facilities for technical interchange meetings, design reviews, product support, and technical seminars.
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or related technical discipline
10+ Years of relevant experience in Electrical Engineering
Experience designing, developing, and qualifying aircraft components
DO-254 experience
Experience with design, validation, and verification of requirements, design, and implementation of VHDL code for programmable logic devices
Embedded experience
Strong background in project engineering
Knowledge of embedded digital circuitry and software control
Knowledge of circuit design and development with microcontroller/microprocessor based systems
Knowledge of equipment used in testing Electronic, Aerospace, and/or Defense products
Good technical writing and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in common office software
Ability to perform technical writing assignments including test specifications, hardware requirements, and customer proposals
Cooperative, helpful attitude with the ability to build positive working relationships across all plant levels
This position requires access to controlled data or information; only [Location masked] persons will be considered, as [Company name masked] is bound by ITAR as a [Location masked] Department of Defense contractor
Preferred Requirements
Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline
Experience with Altium
Experience in Aerospace product development processes
Experience with IPC standards
